userStories.title: One clustering call per week with truncated first turns
acceptanceCriteria: All in-window sessions are sent in a single LLM call to the cheap-tier model from the user's primary provider
Each session block includes session_id, first user turn truncated to 400 chars, project_hint, and started_at
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Coverage validation: each session_id appears exactly once
acceptanceCriteria: If any input session_id is missing or duplicated in the response, the call is re-prompted once with the validation error
Invented session_ids that were not in the input are rejected and trigger the same re-prompt
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Singleton fallback on second protocol failure
acceptanceCriteria: If the second attempt also fails validation, the system falls back to one task per session
Fallback labels are the first 5 words of each session's first user turn
Fallback tasks are persisted with label_source='fallback'
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Label and task_type validation
acceptanceCriteria: Labels longer than 60 chars or containing 'I', 'you', 'the user', or 'the assistant' are rejected
task_type must be one of: debugging, refactoring, building_new, planning, learning, research, ops, other
Invalid labels or task_types trigger the re-prompt path
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Anti-collapse and anti-singleton re-prompts
acceptanceCriteria: If the response has exactly one task and N > 6 sessions, the call is re-prompted once to split when work is genuinely distinct
If every task has exactly one session and N > 8, the call is re-prompted once
After the single retry, the response is accepted regardless of shape
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
